name: Blue Lake Studio
purpose: Local two-Fire-TV studio monitor control for photography and video workflows.

control_model.scope: Devices owned or administered by the operator on a private studio LAN

studio_modes.name: Capture One
studio_modes.description: Prepare Fire TVs for photo proofing and client viewing while calibrated edit output remains primary.

studio_modes.name: DaVinci
studio_modes.description: Prepare Fire TVs for review playback while Resolve monitoring remains direct/calibrated.

studio_modes.name: Client Review
studio_modes.description: Wake room displays and prepare browser or receiver app launch targets.

studio_modes.name: Mirror Check
studio_modes.description: Confirm both screens are reachable before a tether or review session.

guardrails.name: Dry Run Default
guardrails.description: ADB commands are logged but not executed unless BLUE_LAKE_ENABLE_ADB=true.

guardrails.name: Local Device Scope
guardrails.description: Controls are intended only for Fire TVs owned or administered by the studio operator.

guardrails.name: Reference Monitor Honesty
guardrails.description: Fire TVs are treated as client/reference displays, not color-critical monitors.
